notes.title: Corrected capture differs in representation from the original
notes.detail: structure.r4.json is described as the same schema, but text.align is absent on 84/84 text nodes, stroke is [{w,a,c}] instead of [colour, alpha, align] on 38 nodes (alpha dropped, width added), and component display names changed on 36 nodes (e.g. "Button / Button/Primary" -> "Primary"). These were normalised before diffing, so text alignment (for example the centred H1) cannot be verified.

notes.title: DSC container values are rounded
notes.detail: DSC breakpoints md.container = 691 but canvas x (1 - 2 x 5 %) = 691.2; the Penpot tablet text columns and containers are 691.2 (checks use the derived value). sm.container = 337 vs derived 337.5; the Penpot mobile board uses 337.

notes.title: Corrected text columns switched from hug (vs auto) to fixed height
notes.detail: 8/8 desktop/tablet text-column boards changed flex.vs from auto to fix (and child.vs where present) as part of the direct correction. The DSC does not govern vertical sizing; the heights are the re-wrapped content heights. Recorded for awareness only.

notes.title: Features Grid gap is outside R4-05 and not fully on DSC tokens
notes.detail: DSC features gridGap stays on fs.token.space.gap.8 (32). Observed, untouched by R4: desktop gap [32,32] tokens {"columnGap":"cd.space.gap-8"} (unchanged from original: true); tablet gap [32,32] tokens null (unchanged from original: true); mobile gap [0,0] tokens null (unchanged from original: true). The desktop columnGap token is named "cd.space.gap-8" (not a DSC-mapped Penpot token name), tablet has no token binding, and mobile is a stacked list with 0 gap.

notes.title: Right-column hero image interpretation
notes.detail: DSC columnInsetRule pins the right column's right edge to the inset. The check requires every right image to end at or inside width - inset and the first (Image5) to end exactly at it; the second right image is offset left by its own vw rule (right-[54vw] / right-[50vw]) and legitimately ends well inside.

notes.title: Reconciliation record x values are page-absolute
